Name: Dominican Cooking
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]Dominican Cooking by CosmicSweetpea[/b]

Bring the heart of a Dominican kitchen to Stardew Valley with over 20 new groceries, pantry staples, cooking components, and traditional homemade recipes. Learn authentic Dominican recipes from Gus as you become friends, stock your pantry with familiar ingredients, and cook everything from comforting bowls of Sancocho to creamy Tres Leches. Whether you grew up eating these dishes or you're discovering them for the first time, this mod celebrates the warmth of Dominican home cooking.
